title: Ancillary and Optional Services Billing: Payer Claim Filing Limits
content:
Ancillary and Optional Services Billing claims a covered ancillary item to the payer that covers it within that payer's filing limit, counted from the date of service. The limits are the same in every ancillary account tier.

| Limit | Value (every tier) |
|---|---|
| Months after the date of service within which a Medicare Part B claim must be filed | 12 months |
| Days after the date of service within which a Medical Assistance claim must be filed | 180 days |
| The resident may be billed for an item the center failed to claim in time | No |

## Illustrations (hypothetical dates)

- A Part B item supplied on 23 October 2025 and claimed on 14 September 2026 is claimed within 12 months after its date of service; claimed on 9 December 2026, it is not.
- A Medical Assistance item supplied on 9 March 2026 and claimed on 2 June 2026 is claimed within 180 days after its date of service; claimed on 20 January 2027, it is not.
- In either case, an item the center failed to claim in time is not billed to the resident, in any tier.
